page.overview:
Who is Seaine Herimon?

Seaine Herimon is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah and a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower., Seaine Herimon}}

Seaine is a Murandian with watery blue eyes and thick black hair and eyebrows.

Seaine is strong for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is strong enough to be able to Travel. Among the Black Ajah Hunters, however, she is the weakest.

Seaine is the daughter of a furniture-maker from Lugard. All her family are now long dead.
